name: computes the rate for only the requested slice
input: mixed cities, order types, and statuses

name: handles empty, fully completed, and zero-completion slices
test:
assert completion_rate([], 'SF', 'grocery') == 0.0
assert completion_rate([
    {'city': 'SF', 'order_type': 'grocery', 'status': 'completed'},
    {'city': 'SF', 'order_type': 'grocery', 'status': 'completed'},
], 'SF', 'grocery') == 1.0
assert completion_rate([
    {'city': 'SF', 'order_type': 'grocery', 'status': 'cancelled'},
    {'city': 'SF', 'order_type': 'grocery', 'status': 'failed'},
], 'SF', 'grocery') == 0.0
print('ok')
